detail_text: This Pre-solicitation notice is not a request for formal proposals or quotes.Â Solicitation, 36C24626Q0333, will be issued on or about March 19, 2026.Â The Department of Veterans Affairs, Richmond VA Medical, Richmond, VA has a requirement for Medical Gas with Cylinder/Tank Rentals.Â Â Contractors shall furnish all labor, materials, equipment, and supervision.Â Period of performance will be for a base and four option year periods.Â Â Â Â Â Â This acquisition is set aside 100% for Small Disabled Veteran Owned Small Business. The applicable NAICS Code is 325120 - Industrial Gas Manufacturing with a size standard of 1200 Employees.Â All correspondence and responses shall be via e-mail to Keicha.Passley@va.gov .Â Â Telephone requests for information or questions will NOT be accepted.Â Â Â Â Â Offerors are responsible for downloading all documents including amendments from Contracting Opportunities at sam.gov website without further notification from the Contracting Officer.Â
